title: 真实弹窗语义与固定浏览器视口修复

preImplementationNativeBaseline.observedPopup: MetaERSP access bridge created a /loading ghost tab while the opener reached the provider

implementation.safeGetMigration: modelled and permitted only with explicit safe GET proof; Tauri 2.11.5 high-level popup callback does not provide that proof, so runtime retains the popup
implementation.focusViewport: titlebar plus browser chrome and a fixed remaining WebView host
implementation.boundsPolicy: initial show, visibility, active-tab switch, ResizeObserver and window resize only
implementation.focusPolicy: first show and explicit tab/user actions only; geometry never focuses

nativeGate: CNKI, WOS and one additional provider have no /loading ghost and retain one usable page
authentication popup completes and returns to its parent
rapid wheel scrolling shows no black stripe or visible WebView catch-up
three to five tabs remain aligned at normal and maximized sizes and 100, 125 and 150 percent scaling
manual download staging and manifest behavior do not regress
restart reuses the shared institution UDF login state
notes: No old native evidence was rewritten; the POPUP ROUTING FAIL and EMBEDDED BROWSER PERFORMANCE FAIL observations remain the pre-implementation baseline.
The automated process made no real institution request, no Provider call, no paper-library write and no download.
Native popup routing and scrolling performance must be rechecked in a visible Tauri window before either can be marked PASS.
